name: Shelterbelts and windbreaks

soft_risks.risk: The tree rows themselves use water and take land out of production
soft_risks.mitigation: Use narrow single-row belts of native drought-tolerant species on the windward edge

mechanism: A row of trees across the prevailing wind slows it near the ground, cutting wind erosion and evaporation in the sheltered zone.

region_variants.note: Shelterbelt planting is a documented practice for the hot arid zone.
